Forensic Talents India — System Update & Release Documentation

Release Version: v2.4.0 (August 2026 Release Cycle)
Project: Forensic Talents India (Web & Admin Platform)
Deployment Status: Verified & Live in Production
Document Classification: Full-Stack UI/UX & Admin Architectural Update Report

Executive Summary

This documentation provides a comprehensive breakdown of all updates, UI/UX overhauls, database schema enhancements, and mobile optimizations deployed in the August 2026 release cycle.

The updates are structured into two distinct divisions:
1. Part I: User-Side Updates & UI/UX Enhancements (10 Features) — Client-facing navigation improvements, modern active indicator animations, responsive course/internship card designs, program view de-cluttering, review modals, and mobile form optimizations.
2. Part II: Admin-Side Updates & Management Dashboard (7 Features) — Introduction of a dedicated Banners management module with Cloudinary media integration (15-banner capacity limit), unified Course & Internship CRUD forms with database-backed batch scheduling, and comprehensive mobile admin support.

PART I: USER-SIDE UPDATES & UI/UX ENHANCEMENTS

Update #1 — Desktop Navigation Bar: Circular Pill Active State Indicator

  • Component Area: Header & Navigation (Desktop)
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Replaced the previous pulsing dot animation under the active navigation menu item with a sleek, rounded/oval circular boundary that encapsulates the selected tab.
  • Purpose & Rationale: The legacy dot animation caused visual clutter and faint flickering during tab transitions. The new circular pill indicator delivers crisp visual feedback, high contrast against dark backgrounds, and instant page awareness.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Implemented smooth CSS transition borders with modern curved radii around the active link.
  • Enhanced accessibility and visual hierarchy across high-resolution desktop displays.
  • Optimized state management to seamlessly reflect active routes without delay or layout jitter.
  • Impact & Outcome: Significantly improves user orientation and delivers a polished, modern navigation aesthetic.

Update #2 — Mobile Navigation: 3-Column Icon Grid Drawer Redesign

  • Component Area: Header & Mobile Drawer Navigation
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Redesigned the collapsed mobile navigation drawer from a plain text list into a structured 3-column interactive icon grid.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Standard vertical text lists required excessive scrolling on mobile screens and suffered from low touch target accuracy. The 3-column icon grid organizes navigation items intuitively into a compact, finger-friendly layout.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Integrated dedicated category iconography corresponding to Home, Courses, Internships, Services, Events, and Contact.
  • Reduced navbar header height and optimized padding for mobile viewports.
  • Enhanced touch target zones and tactile feedback on tap.
  • Impact & Outcome: Drastically reduces mobile navigation time, eliminates vertical scrolling in menus, and improves thumb-reach ergonomics.

Update #3 — Homepage Hero Section: Typography, Marquee & Layout Optimization

  • Component Area: Landing Page / Hero Area
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Refined the hero marquee banner text size, badge dimensions, and call-to-action button spacing for desktop and mobile viewports.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Excessive vertical spacing and oversized font elements previously pushed primary value propositions and enrollment buttons below the fold on mobile screens.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Scaled marquee typography and badge padding to fit mobile viewport heights harmoniously.
  • Calibrated line-height and margin tokens to bring key CTA buttons into immediate view.
  • Eliminated layout shifts during font loading and asset rendering.
  • Impact & Outcome: Increases above-the-fold engagement and ensures prospective students instantly see key offerings.

Update #4 — Certificate Program Cards: Responsive UI/UX & Card Architecture

  • Component Area: Education & Certificate Programs
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Executed a complete UI/UX overhaul of Certificate Program cards across laptop and mobile layouts with optimized image ratios, clamped descriptions, and aligned metadata.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Inconsistent card heights and overflowing description text degraded visual balance across grid columns. The new architecture enforces consistent card dimensions and clear visual hierarchy.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Standardized image aspect ratio with high-resolution preview support.
  • Enforced multi-line text clamping (line-clamp) for course descriptions to maintain uniform card heights.
  • Structured metadata badges (Duration, Level, Mode, Certification) into single-line pill containers.
  • Enhanced card elevation, border styling, and hover-lift micro-interactions.
  • Impact & Outcome: Delivers an aesthetically balanced, easily scannable program catalog that scales flawlessly from mobile to widescreen monitors.

Update #5 — Internship Cards: UI/UX Specification, Spacing & Color Theming

  • Component Area: Internships Catalog
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Upgraded Internship cards with tailored typography, unified color theming, standardized container spacing, and key batch timeline badges.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Internship details required clear differentiation from certificate courses while maintaining a cohesive brand theme. Students needed immediate visibility into batch dates, duration, and eligibility.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Unified color accents and dark-theme glassmorphism card styling.
  • Prominently displayed Batch Start Date, Registration Deadline, and Mode.
  • Standardized padding and gap spacing between card sections for balanced visual weight.
  • Impact & Outcome: Enables rapid comparison between internship opportunities and highlights crucial enrollment deadlines.

Update #6 — Course Details: Compact Enrollment & Requirements Layout

  • Component Area: Course & Internship Detail Pages
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Adjusted container dimensions and reduced oversized vertical padding in the Enrollment Requirements & Eligibility section.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Oversized requirement blocks created excessive white space and forced unnecessary vertical scrolling, slowing down student decision-making.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Streamlined requirement bullet points into compact, readable checklist cards.
  • Optimized container margins and inner padding for mobile and tablet screens.
  • Ensured enrollment action buttons remain proximate to eligibility criteria.
  • Impact & Outcome: Enhances reading flow and reduces bounce rates on course detail and enrollment pages.

Update #7 — Program Detail Page: Streamlined Curriculum & De-cluttering

  • Component Area: Program Curriculum & Overview
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Removed redundant and distracting 'Areas Covered' UI tabs and consolidated key curriculum highlights directly into modular course topics.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Duplicate information between 'Areas Covered' and 'Syllabus Modules' created cognitive overload and cluttered the page layout.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Eliminated extraneous tab switching to simplify student exploration.
  • Organized learning objectives directly into structured curriculum milestones.
  • Cleaned up UI containers to present a minimalist, professional educational overview.
  • Impact & Outcome: Eliminates content redundancy and provides prospective learners with a clear, concise learning roadmap.

Update #8 — Testimonials Grid: Smart Text Truncation with 'View More' Button

  • Component Area: Student Reviews & Testimonials
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Implemented intelligent text clamping for lengthy student reviews paired with a clean 'View More' trigger button.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Varying review lengths caused ragged, uneven card heights in the testimonial masonry grid, breaking visual harmony.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Set maximum visible line limits on review text cards.
  • Added a subtle gradient fade and 'View More' link button for expanded content.
  • Preserved author credentials, verified badges, and star ratings in a fixed header/footer layout.
  • Impact & Outcome: Maintains an orderly, uniform grid presentation while ensuring detailed feedback remains accessible.

Update #9 — Testimonials: Expanded Full Review Modal Experience

  • Component Area: Interactive Review Modal Dialog
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Clicking 'View More' on an expanded review triggers a dedicated, beautifully styled modal dialog presenting the complete review text and verified student details.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Expanding reviews inline caused sudden layout jumping and shifted adjacent cards. The modal overlay provides focused reading without disrupting grid layout.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Constructed responsive modal dialog with smooth backdrop blur and exit animations.
  • Displays full un-truncated testimonial text, student photo, role/course taken, and timestamp.
  • Includes ESC key listener and outside-click dismissal for seamless accessibility.
  • Impact & Outcome: Provides a premium, distraction-free reading experience for authentic social proof and reviews.

Update #10 — Contact Us: Mobile Form Field & Keyboard Layout Optimization

  • Component Area: Contact Page / Enquiry Form
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Optimized input field dimensions, padding, font sizing, and container spacing on the mobile 'Send Message' form.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Oversized form inputs caused the form to overflow standard mobile viewports, requiring multiple scrolls and causing keyboard overlap issues.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Reduced input field vertical padding and font size for mobile viewports.
  • Optimized submit button placement and touch feedback.
  • Refined form layout to fit cleanly on single mobile screen views without viewport jumping.
  • Impact & Outcome: Dramatically streamlines enquiry submissions and reduces drop-offs on mobile devices.

PART II: ADMIN-SIDE UPDATES & MANAGEMENT DASHBOARD

Update #11 — Admin Navigation: Dedicated Banners Management Module

  • Component Area: Admin Dashboard Navigation & Routing
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Introduced a dedicated 'Banners' management tab within the Admin Dashboard sidebar and router.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Previously, promotional banners were managed ad-hoc or hardcoded, requiring developer involvement for every seasonal campaign or event banner update.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Integrated dedicated Banners routing and sidebar menu item with custom icon.
  • Established administrative authorization and role-based access control.
  • Provides a centralized hub for managing all promotional marketing banners across the platform.
  • Impact & Outcome: Empowers administrative teams to manage marketing campaigns independently and instantly.

Update #12 — Banner Media Management: Cloudinary Integration & 15-Banner Quota

  • Component Area: Cloudinary Asset Pipeline & Storage Controls
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Engineered a direct Cloudinary media upload and management interface with an enforced 15-banner capacity limit and one-click deletion.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Managing local file storage risked performance bottlenecks and broken links. Cloudinary integration guarantees high-speed CDN delivery, while the 15-banner limit prevents asset clutter.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Integrated Cloudinary API for automated image optimization, resizing, and global CDN delivery.
  • Enforced a strict system limit of 15 active banners with visual counter indicators.
  • Streamlined banner cards by removing redundant edit/URL copy buttons, retaining clean one-click delete.
  • Impact & Outcome: Ensures blazing-fast media delivery, prevents database bloat, and provides a frictionless administrative workflow.

Update #13 — Course CRUD: Extended Schema, Batch Dates & Database Synchronization

  • Component Area: Course Management & Database Schema
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Upgraded the Course Add/Edit modal with new database-backed fields: Registration Deadline, Batch Start Date, Mode of Delivery, and Pricing structures.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Dynamic course scheduling required dedicated data fields in MongoDB to allow automated registration closing and batch countdown displays.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Added 'Registration Date' and 'Batch Start Date' datepicker controls with backend schema validation.
  • Extended course model in MongoDB backend to store structured batch timelines and pricing options.
  • Added real-time form validation to prevent malformed or incomplete course publishing.
  • Impact & Outcome: Enables automated schedule management and eliminates manual database updates for course batches.

Update #14 — Course Modal: Integrated Cloudinary Banner Picker

  • Component Area: Course Asset Association
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Connected the Course Add/Edit modal directly to the Cloudinary banner gallery, allowing admins to select prestored banners or upload new ones.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Admins frequently had to re-upload identical promotional banners for related courses, wasting bandwidth and storage.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Embedded an interactive visual banner selection grid directly inside the Course modal.
  • Enables one-click selection of existing Cloudinary assets or on-the-fly uploading.
  • Provides instant live thumbnail preview within the form before saving.
  • Impact & Outcome: Cuts course publishing time in half and ensures consistent brand visual assets across programs.

Update #15 — Internship CRUD: Standardized Form Architecture & Validation

  • Component Area: Internship Management Form
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Standardized the Internship Add/Edit modal to match the Course management form schema, adding batch start dates, registration dates, duration, stipend, and removing legacy redundant tabs.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Inconsistent form layouts between courses and internships caused confusion and data entry errors during batch onboarding.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Unified form structure, styling, and validation rules across Courses and Internships.
  • Added Registration Date, Batch Start Date, Duration, Mode, and Eligibility fields.
  • Removed outdated legacy tabs ('Areas Covered') to align with updated curriculum architecture.
  • Impact & Outcome: Creates a unified, intuitive administrative experience across all educational offerings.

Update #16 — Internship Modal: Integrated Cloudinary Banner Picker

  • Component Area: Internship Asset Association
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Integrated the centralized Cloudinary banner picker into the Internship creation and editing modal.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Ensures that promotional assets created in the Banners module can be instantly attached to internship programs with zero friction.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Directly loads available Cloudinary banners into a responsive selector grid.
  • Displays selected banner preview with replacement capability.
  • Synchronizes banner asset URL with internship database records.
  • Impact & Outcome: Eliminates duplicate asset uploads and maintains brand consistency across all internship listings.

Update #17 — Admin Dashboard: Full Mobile Responsiveness & Touch Optimization

  • Component Area: Admin Mobile Experience & Layout
  • Screenshot:
  • Feature Summary: Optimized the entire Admin Dashboard interface—including data tables, action buttons (+ Add Internship), modals, and cards—for mobile viewports.
  • Purpose & Rationale: Platform managers needed the flexibility to review enquiries, update batch schedules, and publish urgent announcements directly from mobile devices.
  • Key Technical Details:
  • Refactored data tables into responsive stacked cards on small screens.
  • Optimized fixed action button positioning and floating trigger placement.
  • Ensured modal popups, datepickers, and form inputs adapt smoothly to touchscreens.
  • Impact & Outcome: Enables seamless on-the-go administration and management from any mobile device or tablet.
